g.text: Components joined by contracts, in BRIDGE's general names. A BA repo maps each one to a real component, so nothing in BRIDGE changes
from one system to the next.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(238, 242, 255), rgb(26, 29, 40)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(79, 70, 229), rgb(162, 154, 255));

g.text: BRIDGE's agents and kit, what it knows of the landscape, the mapping specs, one work item per requirement. It reads every repo beside it, and writes only the shared model's.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(156, 163, 175), rgb(92, 98, 108));
